data.subject: FRST and USCB filing note
data.body:
Hi,

SALZHAUER MICHAEL's most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in FRST and USCB.

On August 31, 2026, FRST disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1325670/000110465926103947/tm2624389d1_8k.htm).

I publish a free weekly issue from public records and can offer a four-week fund pilot for your team. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
